ticker_news.title: Palantir Gains Fast as Investors Digest a Much Bigger 2026 Revenue Path
ticker_news.description: Palantir Technologies surged over 11% in premarket trading after reporting fourth-quarter earnings that significantly exceeded expectations, with Q4 revenue of $1.41 billion (70% YoY growth) and impressive 2026 guidance of $7.18-7.20 billion, well above analyst consensus of $6.22 billion. The company demonstrated strong profitability with net income of $608 million and announced a strategic partnership with Nvidia.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Fries

ticker_news.title: Why Intel Jumped 26% in January
ticker_news.description: Intel's stock surged 25.9% in January following positive reviews of its Panther Lake CPU, the first product built on its new 18A manufacturing node. The chip demonstrated excellent performance, battery life, and integrated graphics. While Q1 guidance was lower due to supply constraints from converting manufacturing lines to server chips, strong demand for both Panther Lake and Granite Rapids server chips suggests Intel has successfully executed leading-edge technology after a decade of struggles.
ticker_news.author: Billy Duberstein

ticker_news.title: South Korea Surfs Nvidia's AI Wave — What's Powering 2026's Best Stock Market?
ticker_news.description: South Korea's stock market has become the world's best performer, driven by Samsung and SK Hynix's record memory chip profits fueled by AI infrastructure demand. However, economist Ed Yardeni warns that soaring valuations may distract from structural weaknesses, geopolitical risks including potential U.S. tariffs, and the risk of being squeezed between high-tech competitors and low-cost rivals.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari

SPY.title: Trump's Fed Chair Pick Kevin Warsh Could Deliver 'Four Or Five' Rate Cuts, Says Macro Expert
SPY.description: Kevin Warsh, Trump's pick for Fed Chair, could potentially deliver four to five rate cuts rather than the market's expected two, according to macro expert Steven Major. Warsh's nomination has rattled markets due to his different views on monetary policy, including criticism of the Fed's reliance on monthly inflation and jobs reports. The S&P 500 ETF fell on the nomination announcement, while gold, silver, and crypto assets also declined.
SPY.author: Namrata Sen

SPY.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Futures Pare Losses, S&P 500 Gain Amid Gold, Silver Rebound— Palantir Technologies, SanDisk, PepsiCo In Focus (UPDATED)
SPY.description: U.S. stock futures advanced on Tuesday following Monday's positive close, with major indices gaining ground. Gold and silver rebounded while crude oil declined. Key movers included Palantir Technologies jumping 10.84% on strong earnings, Teradyne surging 22.23% with impressive guidance, and SanDisk gaining 4.24% on blockbuster results. A U.S.-India trade agreement lowering tariffs and analyst forecasts for continued bull market momentum supported sentiment.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
